classification: actual SDK callback/serialization with inert local input

source_contract.notes: The original paid-model capture entry points were inspected but not executed or imported. This local observer implements their declared callback/filter envelope using native SDK dispatch. No CodePlane decoder, gate wrapper, fabricated context, package loader substitution or model is involved.

capture_commands: uv pip install --python /tmp/codeplane-sdk-evidence/bin/python langchain-core==1.4.7 semantic-kernel==1.36.0 microsoft-agents-hosting-core==1.3.0 microsoft-agents-activity==1.3.0
byte_retention: Each JSONL is copied unchanged from the capture output. Callback/filter timestamps and IDs are runtime-generated and are not normalized. FileTranscriptStore bytes are copied from producer-store/local/inert-conversation.transcript and verified against the SDK's default model_dump_json output. A rerun creates new IDs/timestamps; it must not overwrite these retained samples.
security_boundary: The capture process installs a Python audit hook before SDK imports that rejects network resolution/connect/send and subprocess launches. No such attempt occurred. It disables SDK tracing/export, strips credential-shaped environment variables, and invokes no model/provider client. Full runtime reports and dependency inventory are host artifacts, not compatibility goldens.

langchain.envelope: One JSON object is written by the registered observer per actual callback. Callback arguments retain their values and native names. The observer adds event/timestamp and forward-fills name by SDK run_id, as the released mapping contract requires.
langchain.evidence_limit: Real sync/async tool callbacks and failure dispatch only. No chain/chat/model callbacks, model usage or live conversation. Callback run IDs are SDK-generated, not model tool-call IDs.

semantic_kernel.native_api: KernelFunction.invoke and Kernel.invoke_function_call -> FUNCTION_INVOCATION / AUTO_FUNCTION_INVOCATION filters
semantic_kernel.envelope: The observer surrounds actual next(context), emits native_function/auto_function start/completion/failure ticks and creates invocation_id pairs, as the released mapping contract requires. All argument/result/sequence/terminate fields come from native contexts. The supplied FunctionCallContent is inert local input, not a model response.
semantic_kernel.evidence_limit: Three actual local body calls produce four filter pairs because auto invocation nests native invocation. The two auto/native completion records are overlapping observations, not two executions or billable calls. No prompt-rendering/model filters, token usage or live conversation.

maf_transcript.envelope: No capture-authored output envelope: exact SDK-written transcript bytes with from_property and channel_id. Activity IDs/content are explicit inert input; timestamps are assigned by FileTranscriptStore. No by_alias conversion is used.
maf_transcript.evidence_limit: Actual FileTranscriptStore and serializer output for local Activity objects, not a credentialed M365 conversation. Activity IDs are not tool correlation IDs. The invoke has no execution completion or usage evidence.

unclosed_evidence.other: These captures do not qualify all later producer versions, provider execution, native gates, model usage, full transcript fidelity, or the remaining live producer matrix.
